work_items.title: Report perf indexes + audit-merge indexes + Fleet.LogoUpdatedAt + ONE serialized migration (root of all Lane-A WIs)
work_items.goal: The single serialized Lane-A migration WI (UC-004/005/006 precedent: one coherent snapshot; all other Lane-A WIs depend on it so dotnet ef never regenerates TaxiDbContextModelSnapshot.cs in parallel). Add ONLY the genuinely-missing schema. SOURCE-VERIFIED that UserRole.SuperAdmin + UserRole.System already exist (enum, string-stored -> NO migration), the SuperAdminOnly/AuthenticatedOnly/FleetAdminOnly policies exist, Fleet.PrimaryColorHex exists, and FleetSettings.WelcomeText/AutoDispatchEnabled/OfferTimeoutSeconds/SmsMonthlyCapCzk/SmsUnitCostCzk/SmsSenderName all exist - DO NOT re-add any of these. The only persisted self-service field missing is the logo: add Fleet.LogoUpdatedAt (DateTimeOffset?, nullable) as a has-logo + cache-bust signal (the file path /data/fleets/{id}/logo.png is derivable from the id, so NO blob column). Add report perf indexes for AC#2 (<300ms @ 50k) up front because a later index = a forbidden second migration: Order (FleetId, CreatedAt), Order (FleetId, DriverId, CreatedAt), Order (FleetId, Status, CreatedAt). Add the audit-merge indexes OrderEvent (FleetId, At) and AuditLog (FleetId, At) for the A4 UNION paging. Configure Fleet.LogoUpdatedAt in FleetConfiguration. ONE migration AddReportIndexesAndFleetLogo via dotnet ef --output-dir Infrastructure/Migrations; review the up-SQL for non-destructive ops (index creates + one nullable column add). No endpoint/engine logic here - schema only.
acceptance_criteria: Fleet gains a nullable LogoUpdatedAt (DateTimeOffset?) configured in FleetConfiguration (no default, backfills null on existing rows). NO blob/bytes column is added. UserRole, the policies, Fleet.PrimaryColorHex, and the FleetSettings self-service columns are NOT re-added (they already exist in the snapshot - verified).

Composite indexes exist after migration: Order (FleetId, CreatedAt), Order (FleetId, DriverId, CreatedAt), Order (FleetId, Status, CreatedAt), OrderEvent (FleetId, At), AuditLog (FleetId, At). These back the report aggregation (A2/A3) and the audit UNION paging (A4).

A single migration AddReportIndexesAndFleetLogo is added with --output-dir Infrastructure/Migrations (CLAUDE.md); its up-SQL creates the indexes + adds one nullable column and is non-destructive (rules/ef-core.md#migrations). All other Lane-A WIs depend_on A1 so the snapshot is never regenerated concurrently.
ReportSchema_FleetLogoUpdatedAt_DefaultsNull, ReportSchema_OrderReportIndexes_Exist, ReportSchema_AuditMergeIndexes_Exist, and ReportSchema_Migration_IsNonDestructive pass.

work_items.title: GET reports/drivers SQL per-Prague-day aggregation + byte-exact UTF-8-BOM ';' CSV export (AC#1, AC#7)
work_items.goal: The driver report (assignment section 1) + the CSV byte-exactness (AC#7). GET /api/v1/reports/drivers?driverId&from&to (FleetAdminOnly, tenant-scoped via the Order query filter). SQL aggregation - NOT ToList-then-group (AC#2 rule): per-Prague-day rows with rides completed, cancelled (no-show = CancelledByRole/CancelReason no-show), cash/card/invoice/total CZK (conditional SUM(CASE WHEN PaymentType=...)), price-override count (PriceOverrideReason != null). Prague-day bucketing (AC#1 correctness + translation risk, SOURCE-VERIFIED): Order.CreatedAt is UTC DateTimeOffset; a naive GroupBy(o => o.CreatedAt.Date) buckets in UTC and may not translate. Group by a Prague-local day key expressed as date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Prague') (verify Npgsql translation); if a specific aggregate/key will not translate, fall back to a single FromSql/SqlQuery aggregation - still server-side (AC#2 holds), NEVER ToList-then-group. The date-range FILTER reuses the GetDayWindow UTC-boundary pattern from GetMySummaryEndpoint (already in the codebase). Hours-online is a SEPARATE small bounded query over driver_shifts (clamp shifts to the Prague window in memory, mirroring GetMySummaryEndpoint's sum) merged into the per-day rows - NOT folded into the 50k GROUP BY. avg rating per driver (AVG(RatingStars) over completed+rated). A totals row. CSV export variant via ?format=csv: a pure Common/Reports/DriverReportCsv writer (NO FastEndpoints dep, NO CsvHelper) producing UTF-8 WITH BOM (EF BB BF) + ';' separator + CRLF (AC#7, Czech Excel), streamed as the response body with a download filename. Commit a hand-computed expected CSV fixture; AC#1 orders are seeded at mid-day so UTC and Prague fall on the same date (tz cannot shift a bucket) and the match is deterministic.
acceptance_criteria: GET reports/drivers aggregates in SQL (conditional SUMs + COUNTs grouped by a Prague-local day key via date_trunc AT TIME ZONE, or a FromSql fallback that is still server-side) - there is NO ToList-then-GroupBy of raw order rows. The date range is filtered by a UTC [start,end) window computed from the Prague day (GetMySummaryEndpoint pattern). Hours-online is a separate bounded driver_shifts query clamped to the window and merged in memory. Per-day rows carry rides completed, cancelled(no-show), cash/card/invoice/total CZK, price-override count, hours online; a totals row sums them; avg rating per driver is included.

AC#1: DriverReport_SeededData_MatchesHandComputedTable seeds a known set of mid-day orders and asserts the per-day + totals numbers equal a hand-computed table. DriverReport_PragueDayBucketing_MidDayOrdersStable proves mid-day orders land on the same day under UTC and Prague.

AC#7: DriverReport_Csv_MatchesExpectedBytes asserts the ?format=csv body bytes begin with the UTF-8 BOM EF BB BF, use ';' as the separator and CRLF line endings, and equal a committed expected-CSV fixture exactly (byte comparison). DriverReportCsv is a pure writer with no FastEndpoints/CsvHelper dependency.

Tenant + authz: cross-fleet driverId -> 404 (no leak); non-FleetAdmin -> 403; bad/absent date or to<from -> 400 via a Validator<T> with stable error codes. DriverReport_CrossTenant_Returns404 and DriverReport_NonFleetAdmin_Returns403 pass.
DriverReport_HoursOnline_ClampsToWindow and DriverReport_PriceOverrideCount pass. No PII beyond ids/aggregates in logs (rules/logging.md).

work_items.title: GET reports/fleet SQL KPIs + rides-per-day series + top routes + ratings list + 50k fleet-scoped seeding script (AC#2 <300ms)
work_items.goal: The fleet report (assignment section 2+3) + the AC#2 perf budget. GET /api/v1/reports/fleet?from&to (FleetAdminOnly, tenant-scoped). SQL KPIs computed server-side (NOT ToList-then-group): rides, revenue (SUM FinalPriceCzk), avg price, avg time-to-assign (AVG over AssignedAt-CreatedAt), avg time-to-pickup (AVG over ArrivedAt-AcceptedAt), cancellation rate (cancelled/total), app-vs-phone share (GROUP BY Order.Source), fixed-route share (PriceType Fixed / RouteId not null), SMS count + est cost (COUNT notification_log where Channel=Sms within window * FleetSettings.SmsUnitCostCzk), rides-per-Prague-day series (same date_trunc AT TIME ZONE key as A2, for the B1 SVG chart), top common routes by count (GROUP BY RouteId, join route name, order by count desc, take N). GET /api/v1/reports/ratings (FleetAdminOnly) returns a list of ratings (RatingComment, order PublicCode, driver name) for completed+rated orders in range. SEEDING SCRIPT for AC#2: a dev/test ReportSeedScript (NOT the demo seeder - keep it separate, fleet-scoped, idempotent by a marker fleet/slug) that inserts 50000 completed orders for one fleet with varied Source/PaymentType/RouteId/timestamps, used ONLY by the perf test (and runnable in dev). AC#2 test seeds 50k and asserts the fleet endpoint responds <300ms. Confirm the GroupBy/AVG/conditional-SUM translate to SQL against Npgsql (date_trunc AT TIME ZONE key); fall back to FromSql if a specific aggregate will not translate (still server-side). Append a docs/decisions.md note (reports are SQL-aggregated; 50k seed is a dev/test script, not the demo seeder).
acceptance_criteria: GET reports/fleet returns all KPIs (rides, revenue, avg price, avg time-to-assign, avg time-to-pickup, cancellation rate, app-vs-phone share, fixed-route share, SMS count + est cost), a rides-per-Prague-day series, and top routes by count - ALL computed in SQL (GROUP BY + AVG + conditional SUM, or a FromSql fallback that is still server-side). FleetReport_Kpis_ComputedInSql_NoInMemoryGrouping proves no raw-order ToList-then-group.

AC#2: a separate fleet-scoped idempotent ReportSeedScript (NOT the demo seeder) inserts 50000 orders; FleetReport_50kOrders_RespondsUnder300ms seeds 50k and asserts the endpoint responds under 300 ms, backed by the A1 (FleetId, CreatedAt)/(FleetId, Status, CreatedAt) indexes.

FleetReport_AppVsPhoneShare, FleetReport_TimeToAssignAndPickup, and FleetReport_TopRoutesByCount assert the respective KPI computations. GET reports/ratings returns comment + order code + driver (Ratings_List_IncludesCommentCodeDriver).

Tenant + authz: tenant-scoped so a FleetAdmin only ever sees their own fleet's data (FleetReport_CrossTenant_OnlyCallerFleet); non-FleetAdmin -> 403; bad date -> 400. docs/decisions.md gains the reports-SQL-aggregation + 50k-seed-script note.

work_items.title: GET audit paged UNION-ALL merge of order_events + audit_log (read-only, tenant-scoped, filterable)
work_items.goal: The unified audit timeline (assignment section Audit). GET /api/v1/audit?actor&entity&from&to&orderCode&page (FleetAdminOnly, tenant-scoped, read-only). Merge order_events + audit_log into ONE paged timeline. SOURCE-VERIFIED: both entities are ITenantEntity with a global query filter, so the merge is auto-tenant-scoped; audit_log is near-empty today (only OverrideStatusEndpoint writes it) so the timeline is order_events-dominated, but paging correctness still matters. Design (assumption 6): project order_events and audit_log into ONE shared AuditEntryDto shape (Source [OrderEvent|AuditLog], ActorUserId?, Entity, Action/EventType string, OrderCode?, At), .Concat(...) the two projections -> SQL UNION ALL, then OrderByDescending(At).ThenByDescending(Id-or-At tiebreaker).Skip(page*size).Take(size). VERIFY EF translates the union+orderby+skip+take; if it does NOT, fall back to two windowed queries merged in memory over an explicitly-bounded page window (documented in the goal). Apply the actor/entity/from/to/orderCode filters BEFORE paging. Do NOT project the jsonb Payload/Diff columns inside the SQL Select (CLAUDE.md WI-10) - if a diff/payload summary is surfaced, load rows then read in memory. Read-only: no writes, no state-machine calls.
acceptance_criteria: GET audit returns a paged descending-by-At merged list of order_events + audit_log projected into one AuditEntryDto shape via Concat -> UNION ALL -> OrderByDescending(At).Skip().Take() (or a documented in-memory merge fallback if EF cannot translate the union+paging). jsonb Payload/Diff are NOT projected inside the SQL Select. Audit_MergesOrderEventsAndAuditLog_SortedByAtDesc and Audit_Paging_IsStableAcrossUnion pass.
Filters actor, entity, from/to, orderCode are applied before paging: Audit_FilterByActor, Audit_FilterByOrderCode, Audit_FilterByEntityAndDate pass.
Tenant isolation: the merge is auto-scoped by both entities' global query filters; a FleetAdmin sees only their fleet's events. Audit_CrossTenant_OnlyCallerFleet passes.
Authz: non-FleetAdmin -> 403 (Audit_NonFleetAdmin_Returns403); bad date/page -> 400. Endpoint is read-only (no writes).

work_items.title: SuperAdmin /admin/fleets create(+seed settings/tariff/admin)/list/deactivate (the ONE cross-tenant write) + create-superadmin CLI bootstrapper (AC#3 server half)
work_items.goal: SuperAdmin onboarding (assignment section 1) - the AC#3 server half + the ONE cross-tenant write (guard hard). Vertical-slice endpoints under Features/Admin, all Policies(nameof(AuthorizationPolicies.SuperAdminOnly)) (policy ALREADY exists - verified). POST /api/v1/admin/fleets { slug, name, phone, adminEmail } -> creates the Fleet + seeds FleetSettings defaults + a default Tariff + the FleetAdmin User (BCrypt-hashed one-time password) and returns the one-time password once. GET /api/v1/admin/fleets lists ALL fleets (cross-fleet by design - SuperAdmin). POST /api/v1/admin/fleets/{id:guid}/deactivate sets IsActive=false. CROSS-TENANT WRITE (assumption 7, CLAUDE.md WI-04, load-bearing): the create writes rows (FleetSettings/Tariff/User) for a fleet that is NOT the caller's tenant, so it trips the SaveChanges tenant guard. Reuse the DevelopmentSeeder's technique: set the scope's CurrentTenant.FleetId to the NEW fleet id (or use a null-tenant scope) before SaveChanges so the guard passes; this is the only endpoint permitted to write cross-tenant, and it is hard-guarded by SuperAdminOnly. CLI (assumption 9): add a testable SuperAdminBootstrapper (Common/Admin/SuperAdminBootstrapper) with CreateAsync(email, password, ct) that inserts a UserRole.SuperAdmin user (no FleetId); in Program.cs add an args intercept AFTER builder.Build() that, when args[0]=='create-superadmin' with --email/--password, resolves the bootstrapper from a scope, runs it, and return;s BEFORE app.Run() (never boots the web host). The bootstrapper is integration-tested directly against a DbContext.
acceptance_criteria: POST admin/fleets creates the Fleet and ALSO seeds FleetSettings defaults + a default Tariff + a FleetAdmin User with a BCrypt-hashed one-time password, returning that password once in the response. This is the ONE cross-tenant write: it sets the scope's CurrentTenant.FleetId to the new fleet (or uses a null-tenant scope) so the SaveChanges tenant guard passes (CLAUDE.md WI-04). AdminFleets_Create_SeedsSettingsTariffAndAdmin and AdminFleets_Create_ReturnsOneTimePassword pass.

AC#3 guard: all three endpoints use Policies(nameof(AuthorizationPolicies.SuperAdminOnly)); AdminFleets_Create_NonSuperAdmin_Returns403 proves a non-SuperAdmin (e.g. FleetAdmin) cannot create/cross-tenant-write. A duplicate slug -> 409 (AdminFleets_Create_DuplicateSlug_Returns409). GET admin/fleets lists all fleets (AdminFleets_List_ReturnsAllFleets); deactivate sets IsActive=false (AdminFleets_Deactivate_SetsInactive).

CLI: Program.cs intercepts args create-superadmin --email --password after builder.Build(), runs SuperAdminBootstrapper.CreateAsync, and returns before app.Run() (never boots the host). SuperAdminBootstrapper_CreatesSuperAdminUser (a UserRole.SuperAdmin user with no FleetId is inserted) and SuperAdminBootstrapper_DuplicateEmail_IsIdempotentOrRejects pass, testing the bootstrapper directly against a DbContext.
No raw passwords are logged (rules/logging.md); the one-time password is returned in the HTTP response body only. malformed body -> 400 via a Validator<T>.

work_items.title: RetentionJob RunTickAsync shell (anonymize >24mo orders, prune sms_codes/refresh_tokens) + shared CustomerAnonymizer + gdpr.md (AC#5)
work_items.goal: Data retention (assignment section Data retention). RetentionJob : BackgroundService mirroring OfferTimeoutJob (CLAUDE.md WI-14, SOURCE-VERIFIED): a thin ExecuteAsync PeriodicTimer(interval, timeProvider) shell + a public RunTickAsync(ct) holding all logic (tests call RunTickAsync directly - deterministic, no timer waits; time-advancing tests create their OWN TaxiApiFactory per CLAUDE.md WI-13). Per tick: (1) scan orders cross-tenant via IgnoreQueryFilters for CreatedAt older than 24 months (timeProvider.GetUtcNow() - 24 months) where not already anonymized; per order open a fresh scope, set CurrentTenant.FleetId = order.FleetId, and anonymize via the shared Common/Gdpr/CustomerAnonymizer (null CustomerUserId, CustomerPhone='+420000000000', CustomerName='Anonymizovano' - order row KEPT). (2) delete sms_codes with ExpiresAt (or CreatedAt) older than 1 day. (3) delete refresh_tokens expired more than 30 days ago. Driver-position history retention is NOT in v1 (document in docs/decisions.md). Register the job in JobsServiceExtensions.AddJobs. The shared CustomerAnonymizer is a pure-ish helper (mutates a passed Order's customer fields) reused by A8 - A8 depends_on A7 to serialize that shared file. Write docs/gdpr.md (cs + en: what is stored, why, how long) suitable for the customer-app footer link.
acceptance_criteria: RetentionJob mirrors OfferTimeoutJob: thin ExecuteAsync PeriodicTimer(timeProvider) shell + public RunTickAsync(ct); tests construct the job and call RunTickAsync directly. The scan uses IgnoreQueryFilters cross-tenant; each order is anonymized in a fresh scope with CurrentTenant.FleetId set from the order. Registered via AddJobs.

AC#5: RetentionJob_AnonymizesOrderOlderThan24Months anonymizes a 25-month-old order (CustomerUserId null, phone '+420000000000', name 'Anonymizovano', order row kept); RetentionJob_LeavesOrderUnder24Months leaves a 23-month-old order intact. Both use the injected TimeProvider for 'now'.

RetentionJob_DeletesExpiredSmsCodes (sms_codes >1 day removed) and RetentionJob_DeletesOldRefreshTokens (refresh_tokens expired >30 days removed) pass. RetentionJob_IsTenantScopedPerFleet proves per-fleet scope isolation during anonymization.

The shared CustomerAnonymizer is used here and by A8 (no duplicated logic); CustomerAnonymizer_SetsSentinelPhoneAndName_KeepsOrderRow passes. docs/gdpr.md (cs + en) and a docs/decisions.md note (driver-position retention deferred) are added. No PII beyond ids in logs.

work_items.title: DELETE customers/me SMS-code-confirmed GDPR self-deletion (anonymize orders via shared CustomerAnonymizer, delete User) (AC#6)
work_items.goal: Customer GDPR self-deletion (assignment section Data retention). New slice Features/Customers/DeleteMe: DELETE /api/v1/customers/me (Policies CustomerOnly), confirmed by an SMS code. SOURCE-VERIFIED the existing SMS flow: Features/Auth/RequestCode + VerifyCode use the SmsCode entity (Phone, CodeHash, ExpiresAt, Attempts, UsedAt). The delete endpoint accepts a body { code } (the SMS code the customer already requested via the existing RequestCode flow for their phone), validates it against the SmsCode row (hash match, not expired, not used) exactly as VerifyCode does, and on success: (1) anonymize ALL of the caller's orders via the shared Common/Gdpr/CustomerAnonymizer from A7 (orders KEPT, customer fields sentinel-ized) so they remain in reports anonymized (AC#6); (2) delete the User row (and their refresh_tokens/push_subscriptions). Resolve the caller's UserId from the sub claim and their phone from the User row to find the SmsCode. Depends_on A7 to reuse CustomerAnonymizer (serializes the shared file). No migration.
acceptance_criteria: DELETE customers/me (CustomerOnly) accepts a { code } body, validates it against the caller's SmsCode row (hash + not expired + not used, mirroring VerifyCode), and on success anonymizes the caller's orders via the shared CustomerAnonymizer (orders KEPT) and deletes the User row (+ their refresh_tokens/push_subscriptions). DeleteMe_ValidSmsCode_AnonymizesOrdersAndDeletesUser passes.

AC#6: DeleteMe_OrdersRemainInReportsAnonymized proves the customer's past orders still appear in the fleet report after deletion, with anonymized customer fields (phone '+420000000000', name 'Anonymizovano', CustomerUserId null).

A wrong/expired code -> 400 (DeleteMe_WrongCode_Returns400); an anonymous request -> 401 (DeleteMe_Anonymous_Returns401); no customer user -> 404. No raw phone/code is logged (rules/logging.md - use ids/Reason).
Reuses A7's CustomerAnonymizer (no duplicated anonymization logic).

work_items.title: /x/reports (FleetAdmin): driver report + totals + CSV download, fleet KPI cards + rides-per-day plain-SVG bar chart + top routes, ratings list
work_items.goal: The reports UI (assignment Lane-B item 8). New /x feature slice src/features/reports. Driver report: filters (driver select + date range defaulting to this-month in Europe/Prague), a per-day table + totals row, and a CSV download button that fetches the ?format=csv variant and triggers a blob+filename download (reuse the B-lane download pattern). Fleet report: KPI cards + a rides-per-day bar chart as a HAND-ROLLED plain <svg> component (NO chart library - npm run size must stay green) + a top-routes list. Ratings list. All data via client.ts typed functions (DTOs mirror A2/A3/A4 JSON, named-envelope unwrap per the client.ts convention). Pure colocated modules with their own tests: reportTotals.ts (sum per-day rows), ridesChartGeometry.ts (map counts -> SVG bar x/y/height coords), csvDownload.ts (blob + filename trigger). Czech-first i18n; every new key in both cs.json + en.json (parity test). Lazy-load the route chunk (code splitting). Must not modify /d or /c routes.
acceptance_criteria: /x/reports (FleetAdmin, lazy-loaded chunk) renders the driver report (driver + date-range filters default this-month Europe/Prague; per-day table + totals) and a CSV download button that downloads the ?format=csv blob with a filename; the fleet report (KPI cards + a plain-SVG rides-per-day bar chart + top routes); and a ratings list. All HTTP via client.ts typed functions (named-envelope unwrap); money formatted integer CZK via Intl.NumberFormat cs-CZ; dates Europe/Prague.

NO chart library is added - RidesChart is a hand-rolled <svg>; npm run size passes after npm run build. ridesChartGeometry.ts (pure) maps counts to bar coords and is unit-tested; reportTotals.ts and csvDownload.ts are pure + unit-tested.

reportTotals.test.ts, ridesChartGeometry.test.ts, csvDownload.test.ts, useReports.test.ts (client mocked per rules/web-testing.md#network-mocking), a ReportsPage render + axe assertion, a RidesChart render + axe assertion, and locales.parity.test.ts pass. New i18n keys land in both cs.json + en.json.
No /d or /c route or screen is modified. npm run tsc, npm run lint (--max-warnings 0), npm run test, npm run build, npm run size all pass.

A read endpoint Features/Fleet/GetFleetSettings ALREADY exists (no PUT) -> A6 adds PUT fleet/settings additively and must not break the read. ============ MIGRATION SERIALIZATION: exactly ONE new migration (A1 AddReportIndexesAndFleetLogo): report perf indexes (Order (FleetId,CreatedAt)/(FleetId,DriverId,CreatedAt)/(FleetId,Status,CreatedAt)) + audit-merge indexes (OrderEvent (FleetId,At), AuditLog (FleetId,At)) + Fleet.LogoUpdatedAt - ONE coherent snapshot. ALL other Lane-A WIs depend_on A1 so dotnet ef never regenerates TaxiDbContextModelSnapshot.cs in parallel (UC-004/005/006 precedent, CLAUDE.md). Indexes are in A1 (not a later WI) because AC#2 needs them and a later index = a forbidden second migration. ============ PRAGUE-DAY BUCKETING (AC#1 correctness + AC#2 perf, SOURCE-VERIFIED risk, advisor #3): Order.CreatedAt is UTC DateTimeOffset; owners read Europe/Prague days. A naive GroupBy(o => o.CreatedAt.Date) buckets in UTC (wrong day near midnight) AND may not translate in Npgsql. A2/A3 group by a Prague-local day key expressed as date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Prague'); the developer VERIFIES Npgsql translation, and if a specific key/aggregate will not translate, falls back to a single FromSql/SqlQuery aggregation - STILL server-side (AC#2 holds), NEVER ToList-then-group. The date-range FILTER reuses the verified GetDayWindow UTC-boundary helper from GetMySummaryEndpoint (Features/Drivers/GetMySummary - already in the codebase, uses TimeZoneInfo Europe/Prague + ConvertTimeToUtc). AC#1 de-risk: seed the hand-computed orders at mid-day so UTC and Prague fall on the same date and the tz choice cannot shift a bucket. ============ HOURS-ONLINE (advisor #3): computed as a SEPARATE small bounded driver_shifts query clamped to the Prague window in memory (mirrors GetMySummaryEndpoint's clamp-and-sum), merged into the per-day rows - NOT folded into the 50k GROUP BY (shifts cross midnight; interval sum is a translation snag and the cardinality is tiny, not the perf path). ============ AUDIT MERGE (advisor #4): A4 projects order_events + audit_log to one AuditEntryDto, .Concat(...) -> SQL UNION ALL, OrderByDescending(At).Skip().Take(); the developer VERIFIES EF translates the union+paging, else falls back to two windowed queries merged in memory over an explicitly-bounded page window (documented). Both entities are ITenantEntity so the merge is auto-tenant-scoped; audit_log is near-empty today (only OverrideStatusEndpoint writes it, SOURCE-VERIFIED). jsonb Payload/Diff are NEVER projected in the SQL Select (CLAUDE.md WI-10). ============ CROSS-TENANT WRITE (AC#3, carry-forward, load-bearing, advisor #6): A5 POST admin/fleets is the ONE cross-tenant write - it writes FleetSettings/Tariff/FleetAdmin-User for a fleet that is NOT the caller's tenant, tripping the SaveChanges tenant guard (CLAUDE.md WI-04). Reuse the DevelopmentSeeder technique (set the scope's CurrentTenant.FleetId to the NEW fleet id, or a null-tenant scope) so the guard passes; hard-guarded by SuperAdminOnly; AdminFleets_Create_NonSuperAdmin_Returns403 is the mandatory negative test. ============ CLI create-superadmin (advisor #5, assumption 9): a testable SuperAdminBootstrapper.CreateAsync + a Program.cs args intercept AFTER builder.Build() that runs it and return;s BEFORE app.Run() (never boots the web host, mirrors the jobs RunTick testable-shell); the bootstrapper is integration-tested directly against a DbContext.
